001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.keyvalues.contributor;
002
003import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
004
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues.MutableKeyValues;
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor;
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry;
010
011/**
012 * Key values added to every event, registered as the
013 * {@link KeyValuesContributor.Source.Standard#DEFAULTS} source so every other source
014 * overrides them on a key collision. Values come from the {@value #DEFAULTS_PROPERTY}
015 * property and from code; a property value wins over a value set in code for the same
016 * key. For example: <pre><code>
017 * logging.keyvalues.contributor.defaults=git.commit=abc123&amp;instance.id=i-42
018 * </code></pre> or from code, which may change values at any time: <pre><code>
019 * DefaultKeyValues.of(config.serviceRegistry()).put("app_status", "READY");
020 * </code></pre> Every change copies the values once into an immutable snapshot that
021 * events then share, so reading them per event costs one volatile read. Disable them with
022 * <code>logging.keyvalues.disabled=defaults</code>.
023 */
024public final class DefaultKeyValues implements KeyValuesContributor {
025
026        /**
027         * Property prefix of this module.
028         */
029        public static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "keyvalues.contributor.";
030
031        /**
032         * Key values added to every event, as a map property, in the order the property
033         * source gives them, which for the URI query form (<code>a=1&amp;b=2</code>) is the
034         * order declared.
035         */
036        public static final String DEFAULTS_PROPERTY = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "defaults";
037
038        private final Object lock = new Object();
039
040        private KeyValues configured = KeyValues.of();
041
042        private KeyValues programmatic = KeyValues.of();
043
044        private volatile KeyValues current = KeyValues.of();
045
046        private DefaultKeyValues() {
047        }
048
049        /**
050         * Finds the default key values in a service registry, creating them if needed.
051         * @param registry usually {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig#serviceRegistry()}.
052         * @return the default key values of that registry.
053         */
054        public static DefaultKeyValues of(ServiceRegistry registry) {
055                return registry.putIfAbsent(DefaultKeyValues.class, DefaultKeyValues::new);
056        }
057
058        @Override
059        public KeyValues keyValues() {
060                return current;
061        }
062
063        /**
064         * Replaces the key values set in code.
065         * @param keyValues copied once, never kept.
066         */
067        public void set(KeyValues keyValues) {
068                synchronized (lock) {
069                        programmatic = copy(keyValues);
070                        update();
071                }
072        }
073
074        /**
075         * Sets one key value from code, keeping the others.
076         * @param key key.
077         * @param value value, may be <code>null</code>.
078         */
079        public void put(String key, @Nullable String value) {
080                synchronized (lock) {
081                        var kvs = copyMutable(programmatic);
082                        kvs.putKeyValue(key, value);
083                        programmatic = kvs.freeze();
084                        update();
085                }
086        }
087
088        /**
089         * Removes one key set in code, keeping the others.
090         * @param key key.
091         */
092        public void remove(String key) {
093                synchronized (lock) {
094                        var kvs = copyMutable(programmatic);
095                        kvs.remove(key);
096                        programmatic = kvs.freeze();
097                        update();
098                }
099        }
100
101        /*
102         * Called by the configurator with the property values, which win over code.
103         */
104        void configure(KeyValues keyValues) {
105                synchronized (lock) {
106                        configured = copy(keyValues);
107                        update();
108                }
109        }
110
111        private void update() {
112                current = KeyValues.merge(programmatic, configured);
113        }
114
115        private static KeyValues copy(KeyValues keyValues) {
116                return copyMutable(keyValues).freeze();
117        }
118
119        private static MutableKeyValues copyMutable(KeyValues keyValues) {
120                var kvs = MutableKeyValues.of(keyValues.size() + 1);
121                keyValues.forEach(kvs);
122                return kvs;
123        }
124
125}
